figurative_meaning_bn: বৃক্ষলতাদিচ্ছন্ন; অন্ধকারময়; আলো ঢোকে না এমন
figurative_meaning_en: Overgrown with trees and creepers; full of darkness; such that light does not enter
example_sentences_in_bangla: এঁদো জঙ্গলে প্রবেশ করা ভয়ের কাজ।
শহরের এঁদো গলিতে আলোর টুকরো পৌঁছায় না।
example_sentences_in_english: Entering the overgrown forest is a frightening task.
No ray of light reaches the dark and dingy alleys of the city.
note: This term is often used in Bengali literature to evoke a sense of mystery or foreboding in natural or built environments.
